tweets: Kandariya Mahadeva Temple, Khajuraho — Madhya Pradesh, c. 1025–1050 CE. Raised by the Chandela dynasty, its sandstone śikhara climbs in 84 echoing spirelets, every stone cut and set without mortar, held only by gravity and precision.

The Chandelas raised some 85 temples here over two centuries; barely 25 survive. When their patrons fell, the jungle crept in — the shrines lay hidden until 1838, when British engineer T. S. Burt rediscovered them. Follow @yddoseOfHistory for your daily dose of history.
